points: Utilisation is the share of NVML sample periods in which a kernel was running (median of NVML utilisation at 10 Hz in the measured interval, vcloak cells, mean of 2 repetitions).
The GPU works in one short burst per epoch of 200 ms (config.EPOCH_MS), so a low value describes this load, not a capacity.
NVML reports utilisation in whole percent, so a series near the bottom of the scale is at the resolution of the counter.
The ack latency V-cloak adds comes from waiting for the epoch to close, not from GPU compute (docs/REPORT_CH4_NOTES.md section 4.E.3).
Low utilisation is not evidence of headroom or of how the system scales: scaling is untested (ADR-028).
Populations are users in two-party conversations, two users per conversation (ADR-027).
